classifier.title: Flow Classifier
classifier.description: Source-scoped evidence, TCP lifecycle, causal discovery and transactional rollout diagnostics
classifier.safetyBanner: This console is fail-open and diagnostics-first. Discovery never changes production automatically; destructive actions and raw exports require explicit gates.

capture.title: Capture envelope
capture.offloadWarning: Hardware flow offload bypass is suspected. Classifier/reassembly evidence may be incomplete; promotion must remain blocked.
capture.notReady: Capture path is not ready. Mutating actions and rollout must remain fail-open/blocked.
capture.countersDescription: First-N, direction, lifecycle and processed-bypass observations exposed by bounded metrics.
capture.noCounters: No capture counters are available; capability visibility is unavailable rather than assumed.

evidence.title: Source-scoped evidence
evidence.description: Privacy-safe candidate evidence used by the phased classifier.
evidence.empty: No evidence is available in the current issue bundle.

flows.title: Active flow diagnostics
flows.description: FSM phase, selected evidence, reassembly outcome and the latest trace event.
flows.empty: No flow-scoped trace events are available.
flows.actionVisibility: ActionToken identity is not exposed per flow by the current issue-bundle contract. Applied/suppressed reasons are shown only from bounded aggregate metrics.
flows.noActionCounters: No action planner, executor or token counters are available.

dryRun.title: Set / strategy dry-run
dryRun.description: Checks confidence, host-marker, ECH and amplification preconditions without sending packets.
dryRun.noPackets: Dry-run is pure UI policy evaluation. It never sends, injects, holds or rewrites a packet.
dryRun.clearHost: Clear or reassembled host is available
dryRun.disabledStrategy: This optional strategy is disabled in the current runtime configuration.

discovery.title: Isolated Discovery
discovery.description: Baseline-none, production baseline, candidate outcomes and causal verdicts.
discovery.manualOnly: Discovery results are diagnostic candidates only. Production apply requires an explicit canary and transactional promotion.
discovery.noVerdicts: No structured probe outcomes are available.
discovery.noHistory: No completed Discovery history is available.

inbox.title: Passive Failure Candidate Inbox
inbox.description: Correlated source-scoped candidates. No destructive action is triggered automatically.
inbox.empty: No passive failure candidates are active.

lab.title: Real ClientHello Laboratory
lab.description: Compare privacy-safe capture metadata, compiled size and MTU fit.
lab.privacy: Raw ClientHello bytes stay local and are excluded from normal exports. Profile metadata is redacted and bounded.
lab.empty: No retained ClientHello profiles are available.

rollout.title: Canary / promote / rollback
rollout.description: Transactional generation controls, last-good policy and diagnostic history.
rollout.unavailable: The runtime-control action endpoint is not connected to the HTTP control plane yet. Controls are intentionally visible but disabled rather than falling back to a non-transactional config save.
rollout.prepareFirst: Prepare and review a candidate first.
rollout.prepared: Candidate configuration exported for offline review. No runtime change was applied.
rollout.noHistory: No promotion or rollback events are present in the current trace.
rollout.lastGoodUnavailable: The last-good manifest is not exposed by the current HTTP API. The UI shows only bounded promote/rollback trace history and does not infer a usable rollback target.
rollout.available: Transactional runtime control is connected and ready for scoped candidate operations.
rollout.disabled: Transactional apply is disabled in classifier feature flags.

privacy.title: Raw artifact confirmation
privacy.warning: Raw ClientHello or packet artifacts can contain sensitive client and destination data. Keep them local, time-bound and share only after review.
privacy.confirm: I understand the privacy risk and explicitly request a raw-capable export envelope.

isolation.title: Cross-service isolation
isolation.description: Per-set domain authorization, provisional candidate revocation, scoped cache/route state, and negative-control rollout status.
isolation.unsafeLegacy: {{count}} set(s) use unsafe legacy domain scope. Review the migration preview before apply.

hardening.title: GSO / passive RST hardening
hardening.description: Read-only, privacy-safe capability, topology, token, evidence and rollback diagnostics.
hardening.unavailable: Hardening status is unavailable. The UI does not infer capability or enforcement readiness.
hardening.fullWarning: Full GSO packet actions are an expert-only mode. Keep them disabled until target validation proves normalizer readiness and unchanged fail-open behavior.
hardening.aggressiveWarning: Aggressive passive RST suppression is destructive and expert-only. It requires explicit scopes, confirmation, complete visibility and target validation.
